signal.mechanism: Forecast hurricane threat can cause Gulf offshore oil shut-ins; test subsequent Brent supply-risk premium against a broad Atlantic hurricane control
signal.primary: long BR when a latest sampled NHC forecast has >=64kt at any still-future point within72hours of issue, latitude24..31N and longitude83..98W inclusive
signal.control: long BR under the same clock, horizon and wind rules, without the Gulf geographic filter; not promotable after seeing results
signal.decision_clock: 18:45 Europe/Moscow on completed MOEX decision day
signal.fill_policy: next actual daily open; cancel new exposure if no qualifying forecast point remains after10:00Moscow of planned fill day
signal.source_sampling: latest versioned fstadv file by suffix timestamp for each Atlantic storm/date, at or before14:00UTC; no unversioned final files, HURDAT2 or ex-post realized tracks
signal.availability: max(explicit UTC advisory issue, filename version clock)+1hour; archive/version clocks do not prove delivery or cryptographic immutability
signal.expiry: sampled forecast expires after48hours; zero thereafter is a deliberate sleeping rule, not an observation of zero hurricane risk
signal.parse_failure: retain raw/issue; mask both arms for48hours after the selected file's version clock+1hour, never substitute a zero forecast

limitations: One rare-event hypothesis, not a complete20-50percent income solution.20round trips fixed before market outcomes for one asset across8years;5percent only a component gate. Goal never verified by this screen.
Gulf shutdowns affect both oil supply and refinery demand; geography is a broad fixed proxy, not a historical installation/production map. Transfer to Brent after a conservative delay is unproved.
NOAA/NWS original government advisories are public domain with attribution. Third-party maps, best tracks, post-season reports and realized hurricane losses are not inputs.

Versioned issue archives are not witnessed real-time receipt. Filename clocks are checked against explicit issue dates; no retroactive correction joins. Incomplete archival source and limited daily sampling remain explicit research limitations.

Forecast valid times are predictions published before decisions, not future realized tracks. Source-only Ana/Ida2021 examples and index counts2021/2024 were seen before design, but no corresponding market outcomes were calculated.
Daily OHLC/spec/fees/margin proxies and integer fills use existing V64/V78 ledger, not exact historical BBO. No idle-cash income, broker, live/demo or new AlgoPack economic reads.

No sign, geography, horizon, wind threshold, holding, asset, size, cost, year or control promotion retuning after outcomes; development selection is not an independent holdout. Existing closed families are not rerun.
